name: Aloo Chop
steps: Boil potatoes until just tender, drain thoroughly and mash while warm; let steam escape so the filling becomes dry.
Mix potato with ginger, chopped chillies, cumin, a little turmeric and salt. Shape into small flattened discs and chill until firm.
Whisk gram flour, rice flour, remaining turmeric and water into a smooth medium-thick batter.
Heat mustard oil until the raw smell fades. Dip each potato disc to coat fully and fry in batches, turning until golden and crisp.
Drain well and serve hot with kasundi mustard and puffed rice if desired.
tips: Keep the potato patties flat, not round like a bonda; that is the familiar Bengali telebhaja shape.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
